name: claude-design
description: Use and export live Claude Design projects and prototypes from Codex through a multi-account authenticated local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Work with and export live Claude Design projects.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Anthropic's remote Claude Design MCP through a local bridge, supports named Claude accounts with per-call, per-session, default, and pinned-instance routing, adds exact local file and whole-project export including binary assets, and provides a browser helper for Design's manual-code OAuth flow.
defaultPrompt: List my recent Claude Design projects.
Open this Claude Design project and summarise its structure.
Create a live prototype from the current implementation.
